In the Berkshire Championships at Maidenhead DICK PIOTROWSKI split the Stevens brothers of Reading AC to finish an excellent 2nd. Meredith and Merriman, also of Reading, were a minute down.
Despite being without the Stevens brothers, Merriman and MacAndrew, Reading proved easy winners and established themselves as a serious threat to our Southern & National teams.
Fastest times: Badgery (Mit) 16:51, Lightfoot (Read) 16:55, Stevens (Read) 17:02. CRANFORD (Thames Valley Harriers)---March 22nd
Carrying on the good work, Trevor got past Stevens (TVH) and made ground on Wainer (Hillingdon), all three of them increasing their lead over the next few clubs.
